resources.string: Gesture Volume shows a slim edge handle. Tapping it opens the system volume bar, and swiping it adjusts volume, for devices with broken physical volume buttons. It does not access, inspect, or store private personal information, keystrokes, or screen content. The optional Adaptive handle colour (Android 11+) briefly measures the brightness of a few screen pixels next to the handle so the handle can turn black or white; this happens only on your device and nothing is stored or sent.
